tasks.description: Remove the deleting owner's journal facts, observations, and tasks after verified Storage and leaf cleanup, with cross-owner FK protection.
constraints: Return an exact unified diff in JSON. Local SQL and rollback fixtures. No deployment, public route, role grants, Storage/Edge actions, Auth deletion or broader task closure.

Add one SQL-owner-only function keyed by the exact owner and request operation. Take the same owner lock and invoke 065 before mutation. Protect the delete set against every current incoming FK from a different owner before performing any deletion or 066 leaf phase: care_reversals and first_aid_followups to care_entries, recovery_transitions to care_observations, care_entries, care_observations and first_aid_followups to care_tasks (verify schema, include any additional real incoming FK). Intentional same-owner FK nulling may occur only on the fields defined by current schema. Treat any historical cross-owner FK as a hard hold. Use targeted row locks/serialization to prevent an incompatible concurrent FK link from changing a neighbor during the delete; inspect snapshot and lock ordering. Do not introduce a whole-table lock.

On verified clean graph, use 066 and remove only the owner's care_observations, care_entries and care_tasks in an FK-safe order. Leave all other owner parent data, profile/Auth, operation receipts, photos, and subscription/quota records intact. Errors are atomic. Exact successful replay remains harmless; reappearing object or hold blocks progress. Test clean/upgrade, neighbors including malformed cross-owner incoming links and exact retention when held, main-owner request and receipt, real protective ACL, one stale replay and exact second invocation.

acceptance_criteria.description: Local clean and upgraded rollback acceptance for canonical and malformed owner graph.
